r0.why: Complete reflection back into first medium [1]; needs lower index/higher speed and sufficiently oblique incidence [2].

r1.why: Refraction angle exceeds incidence water-to-air [9], 90 deg at critical angle [10], no refracted ray beyond it [11], 49 and 42 deg [12].

r2.why: Denser/rarer terms [40], dense-to-rare only [41], no TIR air to water [39], arcsin formula defined if n2<=n1 [26].

r3.why: Aquarium view below water line [42], as bright as direct view, startling [43], swimming just below surface [44], calm water mirror-like beyond critical angle [45].

r4.why: No continuing power flow, evanescent wave along interface decaying exponentially [14]; absorbed or diverted makes it conspicuously less than total [15].

r5.why: Efficiency exploited by fibers in telecom and fiberscopes, prisms in binoculars/monoculars [19]; phase shifts explained by Fresnel 1823 supporting wave theory [16,17]; rhomb modifies polarization [18].

r6.why: Most familiar with light [20], also microwaves, sound, water waves [5,20], demo with narrow beam into semicircular glass/acrylic block [21,22].
